cases.name: Sesalie Dixon
cases.narrative:
On 12/5/2016, her body was found on in the passenger seat of a Dodge Ram owned by Ware, parked in the garage of a home he owned and where his mother resided. Dixon’s body was found after being reported by Vernon Mickey, the live-in boyfriend of Ware’s mother, Marjorie Jones. Police think she was killed on 12/4/2016.He shot her 3 times in the head.
